DHAKA, Dec 31, 2022 (BSS) - Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina today asserted that the Bangladesh of 2041 will be a smart Bangladesh where each person will have technological knowledge and the country will not lag behind in the world arena.

"Our education and learning such as e-education, e-health, e-businesses, e-economy, e-governance will be technical knowledge-based," she said.
